nom: Hanskin Vitamin C Glow Powder Cleanser

avis.titre: Love this, substitute for Dermalogica Microfoliant
avis.texte: Wow, this is such a perfect gentle cleanser! I have incredibly reactive skin, and I'm oily enough that I can't use most products for "sensitive" skin. This cleanser takes care of me: clean enough that my skin is fresh and doesn't break out, but it doesn't ruin my skin barrier the way harsher cleansers do. Takes off most makeup (not waterproof eye makeup but I use remover for that). Gentle exfoliation from the particles -- it's a substitute for Microfoliant, although it doesn't have the enzymes (which some people are allergic to btw). Also, because it's a powder, you're not paying for water and a little goes a long way. It takes a very long time to finish the container, even used all-over --not just face -- twice a day!

I never write reviews, but i thought this one deserved a little review! Although it is a little on the expensive side, a little goes a long way and lathers very nice. So it will last you longer than the usual face gel cleaner. It leaves my skin feeling super clean and soft and has a nice light scent too. I would definitely recommed purchasing it if you are on thr fence like i was, it was worth it!

I got a sample if this and decided to finally use it. I always test my products by not doing my regular skin routine afterwards. Used in the am and it's now well into the night and my skin is super soft and my pores look smaller. I am definitely planning on purchasing now with such a great price point as this is not a face cleanser I will daily since it is an exfoliate. I have combo sensitive skin.

avis.titre: If you have oily skin with enlarged pores,
avis.texte: First time using this product, it gently deep clean my skin and definitely minimize the pores at the same time. The skin feels soft and looks amazing. Definitely will be ordering again.

avis.titre: Love the cleansing line of this brand
avis.texte: I became a fan of this brand after I tried their cleansing balm and oil(BHA). First time using this cleanser, it gently deep cleanses my pores and minimizes them at the same time. The skin feels soft and looks amazing. Definitely will be ordering again.

Stellar - wholly stellar. This is terrific. I love using it mixed with only water or mixed in with a few drops of a honey-based gel cleanser I use. Provides a most thorough yet gentle cleanse. Skin is left glowing, fresh, smooth. I now consider this to be one of the very finest facial cleansers I have ever had the great fortune of discovering. This is a real keeper. May it never be reformulated (it is perfect, folks). And may it never, ever stop being produced.

I absolutely love this face wash. Was not sure how I would feel about it as I've never used a powder face wash before. It gives a gentle exfoliation in the very begining but then quickly turns to a creamy/foaming face wash with water. This used to be sold in my local store but now is only online. I buy 2 to 3 bottles each time.

I love that it's powder but for my skin I found it very harsh. It dried out my skin and over time my face became flaky. There is another company that I tried that is powder form and it was extremely hydrating. But I wanted to try a Korean brand. Disappointed. Maybe better for less sensitive skin.

I really like this cleanser. I just got it, but already I can tell it's good. I went to a party, had lots of eye makeup and foundation on, and in one wash this got everything off and my skin felt clear and clean.

avis.titre: This has been a great product for my skin!
avis.texte: My skin is glowing and very even toned! I have acne prone skin that's also slightly oily and after using this for roughly 2-3 weeks, I noticed my skin was brighter and softer, dark spots were slowly fading away. I'm about to buy my second bottle!

avis.titre: Favorite face wash I've ever used!
avis.texte: This stuff is amazing! I bought it on boxycharm from their shop because a powder face wash sounded crazy, very happy I did. I use a face sponge instead of just my hands/fingers. It makes my face so smooth and doesn't dry it out, brightens and smooths my skin. I will never use another face wash again!
I stumbled across this gem in one of my boxycharm boxes. I have since repurchased several times. I love it. It definitely brightens and helps get rid of post acne hyperpigmentation.

First time trying this out normally I use the dermatologica microexfoliant powder face wash cleanser but this stuff is just as great and gets a much better lather! It smell isn't bad I think it's normal soapy smell. My favorite part compared to dermatologica is the cap lid on the Hanskin powder cleanser! I'll buy this again soon but for now enjoying my new product:)
Initially received this as a sample and I fell in love with it. Little product goes a long way and my skin always feels super soft and clean after using it. Quickly became a staple product for me.

Okay, so I rarely do reviews but HAD to review this product. I've made it half way through my first bottle and I'm sad I've never used this product before. Just after my first use I saw such a brightening difference. I first cleanse with the Hanskin pore cleansing oil then second cleanse with this and it has saved my skin. I had very textured and dull skin and now I don't even need foundation most days because I'm that confident in my skin. It's a soft exfoliant that really does that job, leaving my skin smooth and glowing all on its own. I finish with ROC vitamin C gel and I'm out the door. This is a must buy for any person with textured skin !

avis.titre: An Exfoliating cleanser that doesn't irritate my skin
avis.texte: I love this product…it is a lot in the bottle and you only need a little bit to cleanse and exfoliate…for the price I would say…it's very good. I don't care about brands, packaging, smell, price etc… once it works I'll get it… and this is simply amazing!! I'll purchase again!!
Very gentle powder cleanser. I use this 3 times per week. It lathers nicely and I feel it's very effective in cleaning without stripping my aged skin. I love it and would repurchase.

I have dry skin and have a hard time removing dead skin (gross but true). I was shocked beyond the grave when this weird powder cleanser broke up that stubborn skin cement layer. I have normal skin under there?! heck yes!!
I love the way this makes my skin glow! It is fun to use for a kid at heart like me but it certainly works it's claim. I use this in alternate with a powder rice wash.

I stumbled upon this product one day and I am so glad I did. It is the perfect second-step cleanser! I have acne-prone skin so I tend to be sensitive to new products, but this made my skin noticeably softer and helps with redness. My skin used to get horribly red when I broke out but with this product, it is much calmer. The gentle exfoliation is perfect and it is awesome to use after a pre-cleanse. I would absolutely recommend this!
My skin is very sensitive and I have a hard time finding a cleanser that I feel deeply cleanses my oily skin without irritation. This cleanser is definitely the right balance for me!
This works great, Ive been using it for a little over a week and my skin feels softer and brighter already!

avis.titre: This cleanser is EXACTLY what I needed!
avis.texte: A really gentle cleanser but gets the job done. I've only been using this cleanser for a short time (a week), but I can already see a difference in my skin's texture; it is very smooth. I can also tell that my hyperpigmentation is beginning to lighten (I also use Thayer's Rose Petal Witch Hazel toner, Tula Triple Vitamin C serum, and Korres Wild Rose Sleep masks). Though, this cleanser is a major player in my daily/nightly skincare routine.

I absolutely love this cleanser. I have never tried a powder cleanser before but it is easy enough to use. The "balls" of powder gently exfoliate my face and it foms up really nicely. This leave my skin feeling so soft and clean, without that stripped, dry feeling that some cleansers leave. My skin glows after I wash my face. I've been using it for a couple weeks now and my skin texture has improved noticeably. I have dark spots and acne scars that have started to clear up. I don't think I could ever use a different cleanser.

I use this product once a day (I don't like to exfoliate too often). It is so gentle on the skin and it leaves my face looking very refreshed. I love that the little exfoliating balls dissolve. It makes the cleanser foamy and it's better for the environment. I would definitely purchase this product again.
I use it in the mornings and before bedtime. I love how the powder exfoliates my skin while refreshing it with great ingredients for my skin. My skin looks bright, clean and fresh.

avis.titre: Way Better than Dermalogica Exfoliant Powder
avis.texte: I got this as an alternative to the Dermalogica Superfoliant, which I found to be incredibly harsh on my skin. The Hanskin Vitamin C cleanser gently exfoliated my skin without causing any irritation or redness afterwords. I found that it pairs really nicely with my oil cleanser. I wouldn't use it more than a couple of times a week, simply because I don't want to over exfoliate, but it is definitely my go to now!

The product was a unique concept that I never tried before. The powder is activated using water so you have to pour a couple times in your hands to cover your entire face. The paste formula is a bit tricky to get used to but its good if you don't like foamy cleansers. Its very simple and gentle. The best part was its a nice bottle size for its value. The fact that it isn't liquid made it easy to carry on a plane without worrying about it spilling.

i like to use this cleanser in the morning so i feel refreshed and glowy! usually i don't like to wash my face in the morning since i have dry skin and i feel that it's going to take away my natural oils but it does the complete opposite! i have never used a powder type cleanser so i'm glad i tried this out!

First impressions wise, this product is light and has nice packaging. The bottle is not heavy or anything fancy, but I think it would be a great product to bring when traveling. I am not that familiar with powder cleansers so I don't have much to go off of. But here are some things that I noticed from using this cleanser. First, I really enjoyed that it lathers well and that the powder is able to dispense neatly from the bottle. Second, I like how this cleanser is fragrance free. Lastly, after using this cleanser for about two weeks, I noticed changes in my skin texture and it feels a lot smoother! I would recommend this product if you are wanting to try a powder cleanser. This one is great!

I love this cleanser! It is very soft and gentle on my skin and does not cause it to dry out. I love the glow this cleanser leaves. I also notice that my acne goes away quicker when I use this cleanser!

Once I read powder cleanser, I was so intrigued because I've never used anything like this before. As soon as I added water with the powder it foamed up nicely, I was iffy about the "beads" because it felt so fake (almost like xyrofoam) but then after rubbing it onto my skin, my skin was sooo soft and glowy! I use it every morning and I also love how my skin doesnt feel stripped from its natural moisture.

This is my first time using a powder face cleanser and I really liked it. I was skeptical about using it at first because I've never used a powder face wash before bet I definitely don't regret it now. I added this cleanser to my face cleansing routine so that I can exfoliate and deeply cleanse my pores and I can see some results. My skin seems a lot cleaner and the skin around my pores are a bit tighter than before. I have combination and sensitive skin so this gentle face cleanser worked well for me.

i've used this product every night and it has been such a staple. especially when i wear masks everyday for work, this product has helped scrub the dead skin and keep my face clean. i've had little to no breakouts using this product.

I really love the product design! I mean come on, a powder that exfoliates and magically dissolves and turns sudsy? So cool! But in terms of quality, I like how gentle this cleanser is, it gives me just enough exfoliation when I'm feeling buildup. It has a gentle scent, not overwhelming. Because it washes away after you rinse, I'm not too sure how much the vitamin C absorbs into your skin, but I follow it with their vitamin C glow serum and that's more than enough!

My favorite aspect of this cleanser is that it's a powder. This is especially useful if you need to bring a cleanser through TSA or if you're afraid of spillage during transport. Overall, I felt like this did a good job of cleaning my face. However, I didn't see any changes to my skin while using it (moisturize/brighten).

avis.titre: I would not purchase again...here are my thoughts...
avis.texte: I have mixed feelings over this product and I'll elaborate some more. I have combination and acne-prone skin and was looking forward to using this product. The product was travel friendly and the idea was good, but my skin did not agree with it. I liked that when you added warm water, it foamed really nicely, but I did not like the smell. It was almost like plastic and chemicals which was definitely not the best sensorial experience. After a week or two of use, I noticed that my skin became really irritated and red (itchy). It felt like I had a large reaction that dwindled down after some time passed. Normally, my skin does not behave like this, so I decided to remove this product from my routine and the redness was gone. I identified this product of being the root of the cause and think that I might have a Vitamin C reaction in general. If you are looking to buy this product, look into it some more and make sure you don't have reactions to Vitamin C. Note that this product is definitely not a product that you should be dependent on for receiving Vitamin C because you would not receive a lot of benefits from this. Overall, it was okay, but I personally will not be purchasing again.

I use this product twice a week when I need some exfoliation. I'll use this in combination with the Hanskin Glow Serum and gel moisturizer giving me a dewy finish. There's no particular scent with this cleanser so it's good for those who prefer no scent.

I've never tried a powder cleanser before but it was pleasantly nice! It worked well for me and left my skin feeling soft and fresh! This would also be a perfect product for traveling since you won't have to check it in as a liquid. I would recommend it!

avis.titre: Good intent, didn't work for me...here are my thoughts~
avis.texte: At first, I got this product and thought that it would be a good match for me. I started using it for 2 weeks and noticed that I didn't really like the product. I was intrigued by the Vitamin C aspect of it, but in a cleanser I knew it wouldn't be a very effective brightening agent. My first impression was that the powder was cool and emulsified well. It left minimal granules after adding warm water and was a nice airy foam. I did think that the smell was very chemically and smelled almost like plastic. The smell didn't appeal to me and wasn't a very pleasing sensorial experience, but I decided to give it some more time. I actually stopped using the product all together after I started experiencing irritation and sensitivity after using it. My face turned all red and it felt very reactive/sensitive which normally it doesn't. I cut it out of my routine and my skin went back to normal. I wouldn't say the product was the main problem, but think I might have a Vitamin C allergy. Overall, I personally wouldn't recommend it, but I think other people could benefit it more than I can.
I like that a little goes a long way and suds very nicely. It leaves my face feeling clean and refreshed. I like how there is no scent.

I'm so happy I was able to try the Hanskin Vitamin C Glow Powder cleanser! I've tried different brand's powder cleanser in the past but I think I found my new favorite. At first, I was little concerned about the texture of the powder being a bit course but with the addition of water, they quickly dissolved into this luxurious lather and I couldn't wait to try them in my skin. After I washed my face with this cleanser, my face seem brighter and super clean without feeling tight or dry. I could definitely use this as my 2nd step cleanser but I think I like it more as my morning cleanser. A great product at a great price point! This beats any other pricier powder cleanser, in my opinion. I highly recommend!

This cleanser is very gentle and effective. It comes in a bottle of dehydrated beads that are activated with water. I've been using this cleanser for about a month and I like how it doesn't dry out my skin while leaving my skin feeling clean. Def would repurchase.

Gentle enough for everyday use. Was my first time using a powder cleanser, but I am thoroughly satisfied. On a random note, liked how large the powder crystals were! The only con is I had difficulty getting product onto my hand, perhaps they could work on the container.

I like the concept of this vitamin c powder cleanser. I can bring this with me everywhere since it's not liquid. Do not put it in the shower it might wet the actual product. Application: It is actually very soft once you wet the powder with water. It is gentle on my skin and makes my skin feel soft afterwards. I've been using it daily and have no issues so far.

avis.titre: Clean skin but left face dry
avis.texte: It was my first time trying a powder cleanser. The product did its job of cleaning my skin but I noticed that my face felt tight afterwards. I think it might have to do with the cleanser and the dry air so I will need use it for a bit longer to see.

I tried this cleanser as I was looking for something that can be gentle on my sensitive skin and this was perfect! I love k beauty and how the products do not contain harsh chemicals that can be harmful to me. This is now my new favorite go to and I love using their mask!

This powder cleanser is easy to use! I pour a little on my hand and mix it with a bit of water. At first it feels rough but when mixed with water it is soft and gentle. It makes my skin feel soft and refreshed in the morning and day. I can also bring this around if I travel.

I really like using this product. It foams up really well and feels like it is actually cleaning my skin. It also doesn't leave any residue/doesn't leave my skin feeling dry. I haven't experienced any irritation with it so I'm definitely going to continue using it!

avis.titre: Great Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser for Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: I travel a lot for work, so I've used powder cleansers before, but none as gentle as this one from Hanskin. Using a quarter size of powder, and some water, it easily combines into an exfoliating cleanser, that is nourishing and gentle on my skin. The exfoliating "beads" are gentle but effective, and don't feel like they're scratching my skin as other products have, and then they melt into more cleanser (unlike other products that use plastic for exfoliants which is also harmful to the environment). Great for travel, since there are no liquids, and keeps my face feeling fresh morning and night!

I've never tried powder cleanser before but I like this Glow Powder Cleanser. You don't need a lot and it dissolves quickly in water. Not sure how exfoliating it is but my main concern was that it be gentle on my face which is currently going through a sensitive bout (I blame both mask-wearing and menopause). It is very gentle; my face did not react badly to it. My skin also doesn't feel dry or tight after using it. Label says no artificial fragrance but the natural scent of the powder took a little getting used to; not enough to be a deal breaker. I'm definitely looking forward to seeing results from long-term use.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I use it every morning and it is really refreshing! I like how it doesn't strip your skin of its oils when you wash your face with it and it leaves it smooth and refreshing.

My skin feels very soft after using but I do feel like I have to rub the powder in my hand with water for a bit because it's a little rough right out of the bottle. I personally like using it after cleansing with a subtle cleaner first.

This cleanser will leave your face feeling clean, but not stripped of all the moisture. Two and one exfoliator is very gentle on the skin. Leaves your skin feeling smooth and refreshing. Very little go along way so this bottle will last you very long time. A tiny little shake is all you need. There's no strong fragrance which is always a plus for me. Even my husband enjoys using this cleanser!
This was my first time using a powder cleanser, and I'm a fan! It's a great exfoliator and also lathers up really nicely. 👍🏻👍🏻

Usually, powder cleansers make me skeptical because I used a few in the past that made my face dry during and after cleansing. However, I've used the vitamin c glow mask from the brand and loved it. I was more than pleased with this product because it did not dry me out or make my face feel super tight. I've been using this product for about 3 weeks and have noticed a difference. Pigmentation from stubborn fading acne scars have evened out a bit, which I am very happy about. I also like the fact that one of the ingredients is papain which is from papaya extract that aids in decrease of inflammation for my acne prone skin.

So I got this cleanser to match the clay mask and despite the product being a little messy, I totally love the end result. Since it comes in powder form it is still a little grainy after applying water to it to make the paste but this definitely helps with the exfoliation. It does all the things it claims to do. Already recommended to others!

At first, this powder cleanser threw me off. The instructions said to create a paste by rubbing the powder with wet hands, which I had a lot of trouble doing. So instead, I did the best I can out of a lumpy paste, and put it against my wet face. The little powder beads gently exfoliated my face, and dissipate into a foamy soap consistency. This cleanser is definitely gentle enough to use daily, and I personally enjoy using this as apart of my morning routine!

This was my first time ever using a powder cleanser, the texture was a bit weird at first but got used to it after awhile. After using this cleanser it doesn't leave your skin dry and the beads are give you a nice gentle exfoliation for everyday use.

avis.titre: changed my perspective on powder cleansers
avis.texte: I usually don't like powder cleansers because they're usually too coarse for my sensitive skin. But this one foams up to be really gentle for the skin. I personally use it when I need to exfoliate rather than using it daily.

I've been using this cleanser in my nightly routine and am loving the brightness it has brought out in my face. I was super skeptical about the powder formula at first, but it foams up very nicely and provides a gentle exfoliation, too. I think this would be a great product for those who travel frequently because you wouldn't have to worry about packing a travel size cleanser. I also feel like it's a good "two-in-one" product that is gentle enough for a daily cleanser but powerful enough for an effective exfoliation.

This product is the first time I've tried a powder cleanser and I love how it makes my face feel smooth and hydrated! I use it as my second cleanser when washing. I can really see a difference in brightness after washing my face!

This powder to cream cleanser is great for travel! Easy to pack and go. I love the texture it turns into once you apply water. You can make it as thick or thin as you like. But the consistency is always creamy. My skin feels very smooth from the exfoliation and instantly brightens. After using this for a couple weeks, every day, my skin tone has improved and is glowing all day. It is more even and has helped reduce dark spots and lighten acne scars. Absolutely love this cleanser!

This is a great powder scrub, with bead like particles that dissolve when combined with water. Although it is not intensively exfoliating, it is great for gentle or daily exfoliation. Love that it is powder form and travel-friendly. No distinct smell.

I've been using this powder cleanser for almost two weeks and it's been fantastic so far. I have pretty sensitive skin and I didn't have a problem with this cleanser. I love using powder cleansers after using an oil based one and have really enjoyed this one. It makes my skin feel really refreshed and smooth after and I've noticed some brightening as well. The only thing I don't love is the opening to pour the powder out is a big bigger than I'd like and I sometimes pour too much out. Other than that, I'd definitely recommend this cleanser!

I used this product as my second face-cleansing step. I was surprised at the size of the powder granules, they were larger than I thought they'd be, in a great way! It is a very moisturizing powder cleanser, I have not experienced that with other powder cleansers. I felt refreshed, my skin was not tight (not a stripping product). Also, it's fragrance free, which is a big plus for someone who has sensitive skin and am purging my skincare cabinet of fragrance face products. It was a pleasant experience, I highly recommend.

I've received this product and instantly fell in love with the plant derived ingredients and more because of papain enzymes that makes skin glow, fresh and well hydrated. It is a powder which u rub to your wet hands and immediately bubbles up and cleanse your face while leaving it fresh ,not dry. I love it and would highly recommend this product. In fact,I will buy it again.

this was my first time using a powder cleanser and it was a little perplexing to me at the beginning... but after a few uses, got used to the feeling. the cleanser was refreshing and didn't cause me to break out. i can see how it would be useful for flying because you wouldn't have to check your liquid cleanser or transfer it to a tiny bottle.

I was skeptical of this initially because it was a powder but I actually really like the consistency when it mixes with water. I've had trouble with other products feelings dried out or still oily and my skin felt very bright, balanced and fresh with this after only a few washes. I would totally recommend this!

This is my first time using a powder cleanser and I actually liked how gentle it was for an exfoliator. I also liked how there wasn't a strong scent to it. I would definitely recommend this to all my sensitive skin friends!

This powder is a little grainy when you first see it. Once you add water, it foams up and has a nice texture for an exfoliant. There is no scent to it. You can use this as a cleanser, second step after cleanser, or even mix it in. Leaves your skin super soft.

I used this product and my skin is feeling more hydrated than ever! It is very gentle and I have sensitive skin. It glides on and refreshes my skin alot. It is also brightening because of the Vitamin C.

avis.titre: My favorite 2nd step cleanser from Ulta
avis.texte: So I'm used to using facial powder washes so the application isn't anything too weird for me. You just wet your hands, put about a quarter sized amount in your palm then use your other hand to begin lathering. Even if I happen to have a few pieces not already dissolved, when I begin lathering on my wet face the wash does not feel abrasive at all. It's also really nice because my face feels clean and hydrated unlike that harsh, stripped feeling I usually get. Like I've been using this and honestly my face feels/looks like I actually drink a lot of water. I'm really happy giving this product a try since I couldn't even find reviews for this online and it's such a good 2nd step cleanser. So long as Ulta doesn't run out, I'm going to keep on buying this! Also as a note, these types of cleansers last a long time so even with the nearly $30 price point, it's still a bargain considering this will last me at least 4-6 months and I wash my face 2x a day.

I was hesitant to buy this product because there aren't any reviews for it anywhere but I bought it anyway. The application is a little weird, some of it might slip through the palm of your hand if you add too much water to it, but I guess once you get use to it it's not an issue. This product is just amazing! I have a huge issue with blackheads on my nose, they are so stubborn and difficult to remove even after getting them extracted. This cleanser really exfoliated my skin and it was very gentle, like my skin did not peel off but it really went into my pores and reduced the appearance of my blackheads. I apply my serums and moisturizers afterwards and it pairs perfectly with all of them. I love the fact that it has Vitamin C, which is my favorite ingredient. I can't get enough of it. I highly recommend!
